name: Nasty Green
lede: Nasty Green is a vivid yellow-green named by a volunteer in the xkcd 2010 crowd color survey, pairing a plain negative judgment with [[green]] itself.

sections.title: A judgment, not a material
sections.body:
Our library traces this name only to the xkcd 2010 survey, which also produced many other plain-judgment names for this color family; why this particular volunteer reached for "nasty" is not recorded [1]. It modifies the plain [[green]] with a judgment rather than a material or place [1]. The ISCC-NBS dictionary's nearest block is "strong yellow green," 8.3 units from that block's centre, a loose match [1].

Its nearest named neighbor is [[leaf|Leaf]], 2.6 units away and read as almost the same color [2]. [[grass|Grass]] sits 3.0 units out, more vivid [2]. Measured in LCH it reads lightness 66, chroma 65, a saturated, bright green [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: Our archive finds this exact color in only 3 of 23,781 paintings, rarer than 79 percent of the named colors, as photographed [3]. The sample is too thin here to say which painters or centuries favor it [3].
